name: Pininfarina S.p.A.
via: PF Holdings B.V. (78.82%), the Mahindra-consortium vehicle (Tech Mahindra / Mahindra & Mahindra)
note: Listed on Borsa Italiana; Pininfarina's own site says the group is 'part of the Mahindra galaxy since 2016'. In 2015 Tech Mahindra and Mahindra & Mahindra agreed to purchase 76.06% of the shares from the controlling shareholder Pincar; its 2024 corporate-governance report says it is controlled by PF Holdings B.V., which holds 78.82% of the share capital (ownership structure as of 31 December 2024).
